claim_boundary: Offline audit of the Admissible supervised-loop demo path; observations come from static code review plus an in-process driver run over committed fixtures. No providers called, nothing executed, no product code changed.

diagnostics.demo_driver: blank-session canonical scenario executed in a temp session dir + temp workspace; see markdown report section 3

gaps.title: Plan-gate approval never closes the gate; no resolved-gates store
gaps.observed: Approving a plan_gate_resolution item sets lifecycle_status=approval_supplied_pending_reevaluation permanently; plan_audit.required_gates is re-listed verbatim in every subsequent instruction packet and in needs_attention.unresolved_plan_gates.
gaps.expected: A decision-only gate approved by a human becomes closed/resolved with the scope recorded; resolved gates are stored append-only and excluded from unresolved listings while the original plan audit stays immutable.

gaps.title: Needs-attention buckets and count filter by decision label only; resolved/refused items never leave
gaps.observed: Approved and refused (closed) items remain in approval_needed/evidence_needed; needs_attention_count never decreases; lifecycle_status is present in the row data but not rendered in the buckets.
gaps.expected: Buckets exclude items whose lifecycle is closed/approved/supplied; the count derives from the buckets; lifecycle badge visible per row.

gaps.title: Approved side-effecting action never becomes admitted_not_executed and can never be attested
gaps.observed: Approve on a REQUIRE_HUMAN_APPROVAL action leaves execution_status=proposed_only; admitted_not_executed is never produced by any Control Surface transition (Mission Summary tile is permanently 0); attest_executed is only offered on ALLOW items.
gaps.expected: A scoped human approval yields admitted-but-not-executed derived state, opening the admitted-execution attestation path later, without mutating the original decision.

gaps.title: Evidence re-evaluation forgets previously supplied evidence
gaps.observed: Each provide_evidence call re-evaluates the ORIGINAL envelope plus only the latest evidence item: supplying license_compatibility after package_trust_review makes package_trust_review reappear in missing_evidence; after all three evidences the decision is unchanged and missing_evidence still lists two items.
gaps.expected: Re-evaluation folds in ALL evidence records supplied for the action; missing_evidence shrinks monotonically; original decision stays immutable via superseding decisions.

gaps.title: Stale/duplicate response ingestion is warn-only and write-instruction never archives the old response
gaps.observed: agent-response.md survives a new instruction write; re-ingesting the byte-identical file succeeds with a warning and creates duplicate queue items with fresh action_ids (observed queue 1 -> 2).
gaps.expected: write_instruction archives the previous response (e.g. agent-response.turn<N>.md); ingest refuses a byte-identical already-ingested response by default with an explicit override. Framed as ingestion hygiene, not an admission gate.

gaps.title: Closes gates: parsed but dropped; candidates carry no gate ids
gaps.observed: _extract_plan_gate_blocks captures closes_gates/verdict_class/side_effects_if_approved, but segment construction keeps only block_text and a label; the candidate dict has no plan-gate metadata.
gaps.expected: Candidate carries a plan_gate sub-dict (gate_id, closes_gates, verdict_class, side_effects_if_approved) so gate closure can target the exact plan-audit gate ids.

gaps.title: REQUEST_MORE_EVIDENCE lane cannot converge even with full evidence
gaps.observed: With missing=[] and all evidence folded in, install_dependency still yields REQUEST_MORE_EVIDENCE via reversibility=unknown and business_authority=unknown signals that human evidence records cannot address; the only human actions offered are request_evidence and refuse.
gaps.expected: A demo-scriptable closure path: either evidence types that satisfy those signals, or an explicit superseding human decision path that never mutates or weakens the original decision.

gaps.title: HTTP server starts fresh and silently clobbers the persisted session; CLI resumes it
gaps.observed: A live persisted session exists (.admissible/control_surface_sessions/session.json, 32 queue items); the server ignores it and overwrites on first mutation while the CLI bridge loads it, so the two entry points can see different sessions.
gaps.expected: One resume policy shared by server and CLI; a server restart mid-demo must not lose the session.

gaps.title: decide(request_evidence) is record-only with no lifecycle transition
gaps.observed: Lifecycle stays needs_human_input before and after; the recorded decision is invisible in the queue projection.
gaps.expected: Either remove the decision type or give it a visible state (e.g. evidence_requested_from_agent) consumed by the next packet.

gaps.title: limited_scope_selected is a dead end; the chosen scope never reaches instruction packets
gaps.observed: Scope string lives only on the HumanDecisionRecord.
gaps.expected: Human-selected scope limits surface in the next packet's allowed scope and the item reaches a terminal or ready state.

gaps.title: Agent evidence responses become new unlinked queue items
gaps.observed: evidence_response_for_request_more_evidence.txt extracts as a fresh verification_plan/REQUEST_MORE_EVIDENCE item with no link to the gated action whose evidence it answers.
gaps.expected: Optional linkage (human-confirmed) from agent-declared evidence to the earlier gated action; agent-declared evidence stays unverified_agent_output.

gaps.title: Approve is repeatable on an already-approved item
gaps.observed: A second approve appends another HumanDecisionRecord with no guard.
gaps.expected: Idempotence guard or explicit re-approve affordance.

slices.summary: Derived state for human decisions: append-only resolved_gates records; approve closes decision-only gates; side-effect approvals become admitted_not_executed; attention buckets/count respect lifecycle.
Instruction packets subtract resolved gates, add a HUMAN-RESOLVED GATES section with scopes, and split queue_summary by lifecycle.
Re-evaluate against original envelope + all evidence records; define a terminal outcome for the evidence lane.
Archive agent-response.md on instruction write; refuse byte-identical re-ingest by default with explicit override.
Carry parsed plan_gate block metadata (closes_gates etc.) on candidates.
Server resumes the persisted session like the CLI does.
